description: This file defines a mock class 'PersistentStoreImplementationMock' used for testing, which implements several interfaces related to a persistent key-value store, including methods for registering notifications, setting and getting values, deleting keys/namespaces, and inspecting storage. It utilizes Google Mock for mocking method behavior.
